en: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David.

zh: 大衛在獻殿的時候，作這詩歌。

p.src: 1  I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

en: I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
u.src: 1  I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

p.src: 2  LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

en: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
u.src: 2  LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

p.src: 3  LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

en: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
u.src: 3  LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

en: 30:3 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 4  Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

en: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
u.src: 4  Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

p.src: 5  For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

en: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
u.src: 5  For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

p.src: 6  As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

en: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
u.src: 6  As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

p.src: 7  You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

en: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
u.src: 7  You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

p.src: 8  I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:

en: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:
u.src: 8  I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:

p.src: 9  “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

en: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
u.src: 9  “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

p.src: 10  Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”

en: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”
u.src: 10  Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”

p.src: 11  You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

en: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
u.src: 11  You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

p.src: 12  to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

en: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
u.src: 12  to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
